headline: Belly Gang Kushington tapped 21 Savage, YFN Lucci, Wale and more for his new album ‘GDSI’
body: Belly Gang Kushington tapped 21 Savage, YFN Lucci, Wale and more for his new album ‘GDSI’ After giving fans a taste of the project with “OK,” Belly is dropping the full album this Friday, November 13. Now that you’ve seen who’s on it, which collab are you playing first?
